prompt: A customer requests a refund for a downloadable software license purchased 18 days ago, stating they never opened the application. According to our standard policy (refunds granted within 14 days of purchase), draft a polite, professional refusal explaining the policy while offering a 20% discount coupon on renewals.
reference: Polite refusal adhering strictly to 14-day limit, offering 20% coupon.

prompt: Write a PostgreSQL query to find the top 5 customers by total spending who registered in 2024 and made at least 3 orders. Schema: customers(id, name, created_at), orders(id, customer_id, total_amount, order_date).
reference: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.created_at >= '2024-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(o.id) >= 3 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 5;

prompt: Convert the following free-form incident note into a JSON object strictly matching schema {incident_id: string, severity: 'P1'|'P2'|'P3'|'P4', affected_services: string[], root_cause: string, resolved: boolean}: 'Incident INC-8491: Payment gateway timed out due to Redis connection pool exhaustion. Checkout and billing impacted. Service restored after pool resize.'
reference: Valid JSON matching exact keys and types.

prompt: Explain how to protect an enterprise Go microservice against Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) when fetching webhooks provided by end-users. Include CIDR filtering rules.
reference: DNS resolution validation, private IP blocking (RFC 1918, RFC 3927, loopback), timeout limits, HTTP client restrictions.

prompt: Given a quarterly churn rate increase from 2.1% to 3.8% alongside a 40% growth in new customer acquisitions, evaluate whether this signals product-market fit erosion or onboarding friction. Provide 3 specific diagnostic metrics to examine.
reference: Cohort retention curves, activation milestone completion rate, churn breakdown by tenure.
